Step 1: Convert time to seconds. 16 minutes = 16 × 60 = 960 seconds.
Step 2: Find the length of the cable route (distance = speed × time). Distance = 2 m/s × 960 s = 1920 m.
Step 3: The cable path is the hypotenuse of a right triangle whose vertical leg is the height h and whose angle with the horizontal is 25°. So sin 25° = h / 1920, giving h = 1920 × sin 25°.
Step 4: Calculate. sin 25° ≈ 0.4226, so h ≈ 1920 × 0.4226 ≈ 811.4 m.
Answer: The height of Mt. Glacier above station A is approximately 811 meters.
